segments.sn56.44:1.1: “Yo hi, bhikkhave [yo ca kho bhikkhave (syā. ka.)], evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.sn56.44:1.2: ‘ahaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ anabhisamecca … pe … dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ anabhisamecca sammā dukkhassantaṃ karissāmī’ti – netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.sn56.44:2.2: ‘ahaṃ kūṭāgārassa heṭṭhimaṃ gharaṃ akaritvā uparimaṃ gharaṃ āropessāmī’ti – netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati;
segments.sn56.44:2.4: evameva kho, bhikkhave, yo evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.sn56.44:2.5: ‘ahaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ anabhisamecca … pe … dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ anabhisamecca sammā dukkhassantaṃ karissāmī’ti – netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.sn56.44:3.2: ‘ahaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamecca … pe … dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamecca sammā dukkhassantaṃ karissāmī’ti – ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
segments.sn56.44:4.2: ‘ahaṃ kūṭāgārassa heṭṭhimaṃ gharaṃ karitvā uparimaṃ gharaṃ āropessāmī’ti – ṭhānametaṃ vijjati;
segments.sn56.44:4.4: evameva kho, bhikkhave, yo evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.sn56.44:4.5: ‘ahaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamecca … pe … dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamecca sammā dukkhassantaṃ karissāmī’ti – ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
segments.sn56.44:5.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhave,‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yogo karaṇīyo … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yogo karaṇīyo”ti.

lines: Catutthe heṭṭhimaṃ gharaṃ akaritvāti thambhabhittipādussāpanādinā gharassa heṭṭhimabhāgaṃ akatvā.
